12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3433|9ecbac40.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|9ecbac40.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the $r and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3523|a670d938.name: Bowen Brisboise
3523|a670d938.text: So... you want to be a tailor? Very well, we'll see if you have what it takes.

1093-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-accept.text:
Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!

Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!

Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
1093-accept.title: Super Reaper 6000

1093-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-complete.text:
Hey, is that what I think it is? Great!

Now, let's see. Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.
1093-complete.title: Super Reaper 6000

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1094-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1094-accept.text:
This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.

Sputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
1094-accept.title: Further Instructions

1483-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1483-complete.text:
I thought those Venture Company higher-ups were slave drivers, but then I met Sputtervalve, the cruelest of them all!

Ha! Though it's better than being out of a job, I suppose... Or worse, working with that Gerenzo. If you're here to help, I've got something for you to do.
1483-complete.title: Ziz Fizziks

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

2-accept.name: Unknown
2-accept.text: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory.  Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
2-accept.title: Sharptalon's Claw

23-accept.name: Unknown
23-accept.text:
<The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.  On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.

The paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.>
23-accept.title: Ursangous's Paw

24-accept.name: Unknown
24-accept.text: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it.  The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the Ashenvale Hunt.  Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.
24-accept.title: Shadumbra's Head

3921-accept.name: Sputtervalve
3921-accept.text:
I think I might have broken that Samophlange.  That's not good, because I already told some colleagues in Undermine about it and they were very intrigued.  We must find a way to fix it!

Take the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, the horde outpost between the Barrens and Ashenvale.  She is very clever and inquisitive.  If you show her the samophlange I bet she'd jump at the chance to fix it.
3921-accept.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

4021-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
4021-accept.text:
The Horde commends your successes against the Kolkar, but the Kolkar themselves are maddened.  I have reports that a contingent of Kolkar has traveled to the Barrens from their home in Desolace, to seek vengeance.  My latest report was that, even now, they move against these bunkers, from the west!

Face the Kolkar invaders, and end their threat in the Barrens.  Kill them until their leader, Warlord Krom'zar, appears.  Defeat him and bring me a piece of his banner as proof.

We're counting on you, $N.
4021-accept.title: Counterattack!

4021-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
4021-complete.text:
You have done it!  You have defeated the Kolkar!

I will be sure Thrall receives word of your actions here, $N.

Stand tall.  You do yourself, and the Horde, proud.
4021-complete.title: Counterattack!

404-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-complete.text: Well done.  I regret not being there to see you smash those $r into rotting pulp!
404-complete.title: A Putrid Task

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

426-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-accept.text:
The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills.  If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.

The orders have been given.  The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.

Go to the Mills.  Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.

To get to the Mills, follow the road west.  After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north.  When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
426-accept.title: The Mills Overrun

5052-accept.name: Mangletooth
5052-accept.text:
Along with the thorns, the blood affected <snort> other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems <snort> for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. <snort>

I know the secrets of that magic.

Bring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! <snort>
5052-accept.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

5052-complete.name: Mangletooth
5052-complete.text:
Ah, you do understand. <snort> My words were not lost on your ears, $r. Mangletooth may be caged, but no cage can stop Agamaggan's power! <snort>

The touch of the shard, the feel of it... it has been a long time, $r.

Do you know what it is like? To have your power severed from you?

But, that is a tale for another time. I promised you information. I promised you Agamaggan's power. My people turned their backs on Mangletooth. Now, I lose you upon them. <snort>
5052-complete.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

5482-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-complete.text:
Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!

<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>

These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
5482-complete.title: Doom Weed

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

5881-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
5881-accept.text:
The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve $c coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
5881-accept.title: Calling in the Reserves

6284-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-complete.text:
Good hunting, $N! Besseleth is an old predator in these parts... I will miss her not. Take this reward as a token for being the forest champion.

<Maggran rubs the wound caused by Besseleth.>

Perhaps now many more will travel to Sun Rock Retreat without fearing what lurks in the dark.
6284-complete.title: Arachnophobia

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6401-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6401-accept.text: Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! Kaya is alive! We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.
6401-accept.title: Kaya's Alive

6401-complete.name: Tammra Windfield
6401-complete.text: My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! That is good news indeed. Thank you, $N.
6401-complete.title: Kaya's Alive

6441-accept.name: Pixel
6441-accept.text:
Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.

After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!

Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
6441-accept.title: Satyr Horns

6523-complete.name: Makaba Flathoof
6523-complete.text: Kaya is alive! $N, I have you to thank for rescuing her.
6523-complete.title: Protect Kaya

6548-complete.name: Makaba Flathoof
6548-complete.text: $N, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
6548-complete.title: Avenge My Village

6629-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6629-accept.text:
$N, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.

You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.
6629-accept.title: Kill Grundig Darkcloud

6629-complete.name: Makaba Flathoof
6629-complete.text: Grundig Darkcloud is dead! $N, I will always be grateful for what you've done here today.
6629-complete.title: Kill Grundig Darkcloud

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

821-complete.name: Brewmaster Drohn
821-complete.text:
Haha... I never thought I'd make more of this stuff ever again.

You've stirred in me a great sense of nostalgia, $N. Kind of reminds me of the last time I made a batch of trogg brew. Thank you. The memories warm my stomach.
821-complete.title: Chen's Empty Keg

822-accept.name: Brewmaster Drohn
822-accept.text:
Good stuff, that stormstout, huh?

I have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.

Bring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.

Like I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.
822-accept.title: Chen's Empty Keg

851-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
851-complete.text:
Very good.  You must have really stirred up those centaur -- our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.

You should be proud of your deed, $N.  There is much bravery in you.
851-complete.title: Verog the Dervish

852-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
852-accept.text:
Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens.  He is fierce, brutal and cunning.  Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.

So kill him.  As with Barak and Verog, bring me Hezrul's Head.

He leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.
852-accept.title: Hezrul Bloodmark

852-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
852-complete.text: I commend you, $N.  These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless.  In defeating them, your valor is proven.
852-complete.title: Hezrul Bloodmark

867-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-complete.text: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, $N. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
867-complete.title: Harpy Raiders

867-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-progress.text: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
867-progress.title: Harpy Raiders

868-complete.name: Korran
868-complete.text:
You please me, $N. The eggs and the tool. Well done.

And for your reward...
868-complete.title: Egg Hunt

868-progress.name: Korran
868-progress.text: Be careful with the eggs you find, $N. If they break, they be no good to me.
868-progress.title: Egg Hunt

875-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-accept.text:
Hahaha, $N. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

This time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.

Make sure they die painfully, $N. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
875-accept.title: Harpy Lieutenants

878-complete.name: Mangletooth
878-complete.text:
Yes, yes... filled with joy because finally <snort> the Bristleback know my tribe's pain, $r. That is how I should feel, but that <snort> is not the case.

You aid your people and they honor you. Mangletooth aids his people, and what do they do? They turn their backs on him. They forget him and leave him to rot in cage!

I aid them even from locked behind bars and they send no one to save me!
878-complete.title: Tribes at War

879-accept.name: Mangletooth
879-accept.text:
Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, $r. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort>

Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south  of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a $c. Kill them, $r, like they have killed me.
879-accept.title: Betrayal from Within

881-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-complete.text:
You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you.  He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.

Your path is still long, $c.  Let's hope you stride it well.
881-complete.title: Echeyakee

881-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-progress.text: The great cat calls to you, $N.
881-progress.title: Echeyakee

883-accept.name: Unknown
883-accept.text: The Hoof of Lakota'mani is a symbol of the strength of the great kodo.
883-accept.title: Lakota'mani

883-complete.name: Jorn Skyseer
883-complete.text:
Lakota'mani is called "Earthshaker" in our language, and his steps are like gathered thunder.  He is with you now, and his courage mingles with yours.  Together there is no conflict you cannot face.

Walk tall, $N.  Walk tall, Earthshaker.
883-complete.title: Lakota'mani

883-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
883-progress.text: $N, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride.  Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?
883-progress.title: Lakota'mani

884-accept.name: Unknown
884-accept.text: When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.
884-accept.title: Owatanka

884-complete.name: Jorn Skyseer
884-complete.text:
The thunder lizard Owatanka is called "Bluebolt" by the $r, for within him resides a speed that belies his size.  It is said that lightning struck Bluebolt long ago and, fed from the sky's rage, the great beast's energy is without limit.

May his energy flow through you, $N.  For you now keep pace with Owatanka.
884-complete.title: Owatanka

884-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
884-progress.text: $N, there is a new power behind your eyes!  You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
884-progress.title: Owatanka

885-accept.name: Unknown
885-accept.text: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.
885-accept.title: Washte Pawne

885-complete.name: Jorn Skyseer
885-complete.text:
The thunderhawk is a rare beast of the Barrens, and its death can portend great fortune, or great doom.

But Washte Pawne, called "Spirit Biter" in Taurahe, can bring neither... or both.

The pain you felt from hunting Spirit Biter is the pang all feel who make great gains at great costs.  The sting you felt is the pain of regret.

But I can see you have conquered this.  You have learned that regret turns to wisdom, and that through pain one gains strength.

You have learned much, $N.
885-complete.title: Washte Pawne

885-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
885-progress.text:
There is new resolve within you, $N.  A resolve born from pain...

Are you burdened with the death of Washte Pawne?
885-progress.title: Washte Pawne

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

893-complete.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-complete.text:
Excellent, excellent specimens indeed.

The quilboar are further along than I had expected.

Here, $c, take this and get out of my way. I'd better take a closer look at these weapons. We may have underestimated our enemy, and that's the kind of mistake we can't afford to make.
893-complete.title: Weapons of Choice

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-complete.text:
Look at the size of that thing, $N! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!

Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $N.
896-complete.title: Miner's Fortune

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

898-complete.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
898-complete.text:
And to think, we thought Firebough was long dead!

Your heroics have earned you a place of honor with the Thalo'dan Privateers, $N.
898-complete.title: Free From the Hold

899-complete.name: Mankrik
899-complete.text:
$C, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.

Although my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
899-complete.title: Consumed by Hatred

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

902-complete.name: Sputtervalve
902-complete.text:
This is... er... interesting... yes. I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.

But, perhaps I'll have a little look myself first...
902-complete.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

905-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
905-accept.text:
Now, $N, the hunt deepens.  Now you must defeat your prey, and then find your way to its lair.

Hunt the sunscale raptors to the south.  Slay them and remove the feathers they wear.  Place the feathers on the scytheclaw nests southwest of the Stagnant Oasis. Show their brethren you do not fear them!
905-accept.title: The Angry Scytheclaws

914-progress.name: Nara Wildmane
914-progress.text: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, $N.  Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
914-progress.title: Leaders of the Fang

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

95774-accept.name: Mankrik
95774-accept.text:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774-accept.title: Her Name Is Olgra

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

97250-complete.name: Grunt Logmar
97250-complete.text:
So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory.

However, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time.

In any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!
97250-complete.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

97253-complete.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-complete.text:
Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.

Uhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?
97253-complete.title: Parts and Pieces

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces

97538-accept.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-accept.text:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
97538-accept.title: Pigments for Paints

99142-accept.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-accept.text:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142-accept.title: Tomb Weed
